input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs for a three-year term (§8.1) and Section 9 grants only cause-based termination rights (material breach 9.1, insolvency 9.2, security/SLA/legal/IP failures 9.3). No party has a termination-for-convenience right, and §2.1 expressly locks Customer into a USD 2,000,000 per-year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights." Under the playbook, the absence of any Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months is a deviation (missing behaviour). We therefore add a new §9.4 giving Customer a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees (dovetailing with §10.2) and confirming Vendor has no reciprocal walk-away during the term, and conform §2.1 so the commitment does not defeat that right. Vendor currently has no convenience right, so no deletion is needed on that side.

proposal.summary: Add Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; conform Section 2.1 commitment language
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Customer right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, and conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay commitment no longer overrides it; our playbook requires an exit right in any term longer than 12 months. If a 30-day right is not workable, we can discuss 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees, provided Vendor takes no reciprocal convenience right during a committed term.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty, early-termination charge, or acceleration of Fees, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination in accordance with Section 10.2. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience or without cause during the term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, subject to Customer's reduction and termination rights under this Agreement, including Section 9.4.
